deploy_yml:
policy_name: OpenWAM
protocol: ws
# True batch inference: the Isaac client runs num_envs (sim_config.yml, default
# 10) parallel envs; get_action_batch stacks every running env into ONE
# engine.generate_batch forward pass.
eval_batch: true

# Server transport: overridden by setup_eval_policy_server.sh per launch.
port: null
host: localhost

# Identifiers + per-launch wiring (set via --overrides from the eval scripts).
bench_name: null
task_name: null
ckpt_name: null
env_cfg_type: null
action_type: ee
action_dim: null
seed: 42
gpu_id: null

# --- OpenWAM-specific keys (resolved in setup_eval_policy_server.sh) ---
# OpenWAM source root. null -> the vendored copy at policy/OpenWAM/OpenWAM/.
openwam_root: null
# Checkpoint dir containing config.yaml + checkpoint_step_*.safetensors
# + normalization_stats.npy (+ tokenizer/). null -> XPolicyLab checkpoints/
# resolution (explicit path, 5-tuple run dir, or checkpoints/<ckpt_name>).
ckpt_dir: null
# OpenWAM deploy hyperparameters yaml. null -> <openwam_root>/configs/deploy.yaml;
# model.py force-overrides dit_cache/compile/decode_video off + sync regardless.
openwam_deploy_config: null
device: cuda

# Actions executed per generated chunk before the client requests a new one.
# null -> OpenWAM inference.inference_horizon (null there = full 32-step chunk).
replan_steps: null
default_instruction: follow the instruction
# true skips checkpoint loading and returns hold-position chunks (protocol
# debugging only; never valid for a real evaluation).
allow_dummy_policy: false
sim_config:
decimation: 1
dt: 0.004
render_interval: 10
scene:
  num_envs: 10
  env_spacing: 7
